decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed advertisements by reason of their size and position would represent unduly obtrusive elements which would lead to excessive advertisement clutter and would detract from the visual amenity of the locality and the setting of the Listed Building. They would thereby be contrary to Policies ENV 1.1, ENV 1.7 and ENV2.5 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996), Policies ENV-B.1.4, ENV-B.1.1 and ENV1.3B of the proposed Unitary Development Plan (2001), and PPG 19: Outdoor Advertisements.

Condition : 2 - The proposal would adversely affect a tree and landscape features on the site contrary to policies ENV.1.9 and ENV.5.6 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and policies ENV-N.2.6 and ENV-N.2.7 of the proposed Unitary Development Plan (2001).
description: Erection of 8 externally illuminated pole mounted signs.
